exceptions.rationale: No patched elliptic release exists. The dependency is pulled in by crypto-browserify through the opt-in Eliza adapter.
exceptions.mitigation: Smithers does not use this dependency for control-plane signing. Keep the Eliza adapter isolated from security-sensitive signing workloads and replace the transitive crypto-browserify chain when upstream permits it.

exceptions.rationale: The upstream Pi release has no patched version for the HTML session-export sanitization issue.
exceptions.mitigation: The Pi integration is opt-in and Smithers does not publish or render Pi HTML session exports. Do not open untrusted Pi session exports in a privileged browser context.

exceptions.rationale: The upstream Pi release has no patched version for predictable temporary extension-install paths.
exceptions.mitigation: Treat the Pi integration as single-user tooling: do not run it on shared multi-user hosts, and run agent workloads inside an isolated account or sandbox. Remove this exception as soon as upstream publishes a fix.

exceptions.rationale: The upstream Pi release has no patched version for concurrent auth-file writes.
exceptions.mitigation: Use a per-user Pi configuration directory, restrict it to that user, and avoid concurrent credential mutations on shared hosts.
